with_timestamps.text: The puzzle shows IX equals IX plus IX, which translates to 9 equals 9 plus 9, clearly incorrect.The solution is to move one matchstick from the plus sign plus to change it into an equals sign equals.That way, the equation becomes IX equals I equals IX, which simplifies to 9 equals 9 equals 9, a correct and valid equation.
